sql:
SELECT t.*, a.name AS creator_name,
      cl.name AS claimer_name,
      ow.display_name AS creator_owner_name,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM delegations d
    JOIN owners o ON o.id = d.owner_id AND o.status = 'active'
    JOIN owner_webauthn_credentials c ON c.owner_id = o.id AND c.status = 'active'
    WHERE d.agent_id = t.creator_agent_id AND d.status = 'active') AS creator_certified,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owners o
    JOIN owner_webauthn_credentials c ON c.owner_id = o.id AND c.status = 'active'
    WHERE o.id = t.creator_owner_id AND o.status = 'active') AS creator_owner_certified FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = t.creator_agent_id LEFT JOIN agents cl ON cl.id = t.claimed_by_agent_id LEFT JOIN owners ow ON ow.id = t.creator_owner_id WHERE 1=1 AND t.status = ? ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

plan.detail: SEARCH a USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_agents_1 (id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH cl USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_agents_1 (id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH ow USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_owners_1 (id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH d USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_delegations_2 (owner_id=? AND agent_id=?)
